result.instructions: Tools for INWX, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my domains expire in the next 60 days?"; "Is example-brand.com still free to register, and what does it cost?"; "Show the DNS records of mysite.de and their ids.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes INWX data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run inwx_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run inwx_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run inwx_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. inwx_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: inwx_account_info
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get the details of the INWX login used by this server: account id, customer number, roles and default settings. INWX method: account.info.

tools.name: inwx_domain_check
tools.title: Check domain availability
tools.description: Check whether domain names can be registered now, with the registration price and premium flag. Read only: nothing is ordered. INWX method: domain.check.

domains.description: Domain names to check, for example ["example.com", "example.de"].

tools.name: inwx_domain_list
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List the domains of this INWX account with status, expiry date, renewal mode and lock state. Filter by name text or status. INWX method: domain.list.

search.description: Search text. "*" or empty lists all (default "*").

status.description: Only domains with these status values.

tools.name: inwx_domain_info
tools.title: Get domain details
tools.description: Get one domain: dates (creation, expiry), status, renewal and transfer modes, and the registrant, admin and tech contact handle ids. The transfer auth code is never returned. INWX method: domain.info.

domain.description: Domain name, for example example.com. Give this or roId.

roId.description: Repository object id (roId) from a list call. Give this or domain.

tools.name: inwx_nameserver_list
tools.title: List DNS zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones hosted at INWX with their zone type, mail and web entries. Filter by domain text. INWX method: nameserver.list.

search.description: Search text. "*" or empty lists all (default "*").

tools.name: inwx_nameserver_info
tools.title: Get DNS zone details
tools.description: Get one DNS zone with its records (record id, name, type, content, TTL, priority). Use the record ids with inwx_nameserver_update_record. INWX method: nameserver.info.

domain.description: Domain name, for example example.com. Give this or roId.

roId.description: Repository object id (roId) from a list call. Give this or domain.

tools.name: inwx_contact_list
tools.title: List contact handles
tools.description: List the contact handles (owner, admin and tech contacts) of this account. Filter by search text. INWX method: contact.list.

tools.name: inwx_contact_info
tools.title: Get a contact handle
tools.description: Get one contact handle by id: name, organisation, address and e-mail. INWX method: contact.info.

tools.name: inwx_nameserver_update
tools.title: Update DNS zone settings
tools.description: Change the settings of a DNS zone: zone type, master IP, nameserver list, and the web and mail entries. This changes live DNS. INWX method: nameserver.update.

domain.description: Domain name, for example example.com. Give this or roId.

roId.description: Repository object id (roId) from a list call. Give this or domain.

masterIp.description: Master IP for a SLAVE zone.

ns.description: Nameserver host names for the zone.

tools.name: inwx_nameserver_create_record
tools.title: Add a DNS record
tools.description: Add one DNS record to a zone. This changes live DNS. INWX method: nameserver.createRecord.

domain.description: Domain name, for example example.com. Give this or roId.

roId.description: Repository object id (roId) from a list call. Give this or domain.

content.description: Record value, for example an IP address, host name or TXT text.

name.description: Record name, for example www or _dmarc. Empty means the zone itself.

prio.description: Priority, used by MX and SRV records (default 0).

tools.name: inwx_nameserver_update_record
tools.title: Change a DNS record
tools.description: Change one existing DNS record (take its id from inwx_nameserver_info). Only the fields you pass change. This changes live DNS. INWX method: nameserver.updateRecord.

name.description: Record name, for example www or _dmarc. Empty means the zone itself.

prio.description: Priority, used by MX and SRV records (default 0).

prompts.title: Get started with INWX
prompts.description: What you can do with INWX here, with example requests to try.
